project_structure: Full-stack application with React frontend (Vite + TypeScript) and Python FastAPI backend (SQLAlchemy). Frontend uses a custom external store pattern (chapterStore) with useSyncExternalStore for chapter state management, NOT React Query. Outline pages and writing pages are separate route-level components that share state through the singleton chapterStore. Backend uses SQLAlchemy ORM with SQLite, chapters belong to outlines and have global numbering across volumes.

patterns: 1. EXTERNAL STORE PATTERN: chapterStore is a singleton external store using useSyncExternalStore with listener-based change propagation. 2. STALE FLAG PATTERN: invalidateProjectChapters marks data stale, loadMeta checks stale flag. Auto-revalidation step is missing from useChapterMetaList. 3. SSE STREAMING: Chapter creation from outlines uses SSE streaming for progress. 4. CROSS-PAGE COMMUNICATION: Wizard service provides localStorage-based signaling but is not used for outline-to-writing chapter creation. 5. CHAPTER OFFSET: global_number = sum(max(local_numbers) per earlier volume) + local_number.
dependencies: FRONTEND: useWritingPageState -> useChapterEditor -> useChapterMetaList -> chapterStore (singleton) -> chaptersApi -> backend API. useDetailedOutlineState -> detailedOutlinesApi -> backend API + chapterStore.invalidateProjectChapters. BACKEND: routes/detailed_outlines.py -> services/detailed_outline_generation/app_service.py and services/chapter_skeleton_generation/stream_service.py. Both use models/chapter.py and both have independent _compute_chapter_offset functions (duplicated code).
integration_points: 1. OUTLINE-TO-WRITING CACHE: chapterStore.invalidateProjectChapters called from outline page at L301, L314, L391, L408. Writing page useChapterMetaList subscribes but does not auto-refetch on stale. 2. CHAPTER CREATION API: Two paths - POST /detailed_outlines/{id}/create_chapters and POST /detailed_outlines/{id}/generate_chapters_stream. Both compute global chapter numbers via offset. 3. WIZARD REFRESH: markWizardProjectChanged -> localStorage -> writing page detects change -> refreshChapters(). NOT triggered by outline chapter creation.
constraints: 1. chapterStore is a singleton shared across all pages in same browser tab. 2. Outline and writing pages are separate routes sharing state only through chapterStore and localStorage. 3. UniqueConstraint on (outline_id, number) prevents duplicate numbers but allows gaps. 4. _compute_chapter_offset is duplicated in two backend files. 5. Writing page dirty state guard prevents refresh when user has unsaved changes.
